violation_type.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

violation_type.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

finding_variants.text: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.
The operation did not have fire drill logs available for review.
There was no documentation on file verifying that a fire drill had been conducted every month.
The operation has not conducted the required monthly fire drills.
There is no documentation of fire drills being conducted.
No fire drills have been completed.
